{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1c 00}Oh, and by the way,{01 00 00 05 00}
there's something I have to
say to you.
{07 16 00}No matter how curious you
are, you can't go reading
other people's mail!
{07 15 00}This is what they call{01 00 00 05 00}
"invading someone's
privacy," {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}That letter that I gave you
to give to {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00}
I need it back.

{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}You know,{01 00 00 0a 00} it's not that I
don't understand the desire
to read other people's mail.
{07 15 00}But the letter to
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}that you
read{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I need it back.{01 00 00 05 00} Now.
{07 01 00}If you ever do that again,{01 00 00 05 00}
you'll pay. {01 00 00 0a 00}Believe me,
YOU'LL PAY, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 04 00}Oh, and I was wondering,{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 15 00}why do you go around
reading other people's mail?
{07 05 00}The letter you read was
between {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00} {ff 00 00 00}and
me. It was a secret!
{07 00 00}Ugh, {01 00 00 05 00}just give it back.{01 01 00}
{07 15 00}And don't you ever do that
to me again, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
